title: fix(plugin-security)!: an external object that states no organization scope reads as empty for every caller, the platform owner included
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — under the `isolated` and `group` postures, an external object registered after the boot that states no organization scope reads as empty for every caller, the declared platform owner included; nothing is widened, and the `single` posture is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published texts already state this rule for every caller, and this diff changes none of them: the ADR-0087 D3 entry `external-object-organization-scope-declared` ("every read is denied at Layer 0"), and the once-warning in `external-organization-scope.ts`. The ADR-0015 §10 amendment that states it is in #29866 (Tier H, still open).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`isolated` / `group` 姿态下,启动后才注册、且未声明组织范围的外部对象,对每个调用者读取都为空,平台所有者也不例外;平台所有者在其它对象上跨组织墙读取的行为不变,成员与 `single` 姿态不变。
- **为什么改**:安全频道裁决(2026-11-04,选项 A):未声明组织范围的外部对象是配置缺陷,这一拒绝对已验证的平台所有者同样成立;`main` 上已有的文案(D3 条目、一次性告警)本就这样写;ADR-0015 §10 的修订在 #29866(Tier H,未合并)。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只在一种启动时已按名拒绝的配置上收窄一个主体的读取,不放宽任何东西;回滚即撤销本 PR(一处条件)。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-rls-filter.ts` 跨墙分支前新增的条件 `deniedForUndeclaredExternalScope`;② `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.test.ts` 新增的顶层 describe;③ `packages/runtime/src/plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` 的 (h5c)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.test.ts`,预期 26 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule (ADR-0015 §10 as amended).** Under a walled posture, the Layer 0 `deny` an external object earns by stating no organization scope judges the object's configuration, not the reader's organization, so it stands for every caller, the verified platform owner included. In `computeLayeredRlsFilter` the verified platform owner's read crossing (the `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` read door) now stands down on exactly that verdict, and the owner probe is not consulted there. The recorded verdict stays `deny`.
- **Unchanged.** The owner's reads still cross the `isolated` equality, the `group` union and the org-less deny, on local objects and on an external object that declares its own `organization_id`. Writes stay walled for everyone. Members and the `single` posture are unchanged. No type, verdict ladder or published export moves.
- **Docs in code.** The owner-crossing module's header names the one verdict the read crossing does not lift.
- **Changeset.** One `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/plugin-security`, titled `fix(plugin-security)!:`, with a BREAKING section (the rule, what is unchanged, who moves and the fix) and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (already-registered external-object-organization-scope-declared)`: the existing entry already prescribes the operator's remedy.

## Why

Security-channel ruling of 2026-11-04 (option A): the configuration-defect deny on an external object that states no organization scope stands for the verified platform owner too. The texts already on `main` say so: the D3 entry's "every read is denied at Layer 0", and the once-warning naming "denies every read and write". The ADR-0015 §10 amendment lands separately in #29866.

### The declarations, justified

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and the `!`. Measured against the published release, `@objectstack/plugin-security@18.3.0` (npm `latest`): its `dist/index.js` carries no undeclared-external-scope verdict (0 hits for `externalOrganizationScopeUndeclared`, against 1 hit for the owner crossing's audit event name as the positive control in the same file). So this diff narrows one principal's reads relative to the published release, on a configuration the boot already refuses by name when the stack declares it. Nothing is widened. It is a runtime security narrowing, not an accept-set widening, so `no`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`. Nothing an author can write changes; the three declarations are the ones `main` already accepts. The level follows the kind: `patch`.

## Tests

- **The owner crossing's shared unit harness**, a new top-level describe beside the crossing's existing pins (the shared harness's `boot` gains an optional `schema`): `[ADR-0015 §10] an external object that states no organization scope reads as empty for every caller, the platform owner included`, 7 cases.
  - `isolated`: the verified owner reads the deny sentinel (by identity), the recorded verdict is `deny`, no crossing is logged, and no `sys_user` row is read.
  - `group`: the same.
  - An org-less verified owner reads the deny sentinel on it as well.
  - CONTROL: the owner still crosses the wall on an external object that declares its own `organization_id`, and a member there keeps the equality.
  - CONTROL: the owner still crosses the wall, and the org-less deny, on a local object.
  - CONTROL: a member is unchanged under `isolated` and `group`.
  - CONTROL: `single` is unchanged for the owner and a member.
- **`plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` (h5c)**, beside (h5)/(h5b), on the real `isolated` boot: the owner's `GET /data/spike_late` answers 200 with no row, and no read without the deny sentinel reaches the remote. CONTROL in the same case: the owner's `GET /data/spike_walled` still crosses the wall and reads every organization's rows.
- **One-shot ablation** (not committed): with the new condition replaced by `true` and plugin-security rebuilt, the 3 owner cases above and (h5c) went red and every other case stayed green; restored and rebuilt, all green. Readings below.

## Acceptance notes

- No out-of-scope finding to note.
- Pre-fix readings are with the seat.

## Verification

All readings are at or source-equal to head `471f235499`: `packages/` is byte-identical from `111074d2f6` (the fix commit) to `471f235499`, and the later commits touch only the changeset and merge one skills-only `main` commit. Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each reading is that wrapper's `VERDICT` line.

<details><summary>Unit: the crossing's pins and the federated Layer 0 pins (34/34)</summary>

```text
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/platform-owner-wall-bypass.test.ts src/federated-tenant-layer0.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  34 passed (34)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Full plugin-security suite and typechecks</summary>

```text
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test
 Test Files  242 passed (242)
      Tests  5273 passed | 45 skipped (5318)
plugin-security test exit=0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck          exit=0
pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck                  exit=0
```

The first runtime typecheck exited 1 at `check:test-typecheck` on `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts`, a file this diff does not touch. Its import `@objectstack/driver-turso` is an optional peer that the runtime closure build does not build, so it had no `dist/` here. After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/driver-turso`, the same typecheck passed (one `&&` chain, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
</details>

<details><summary>Spike harness: the real isolated boot (20/20)</summary>

```text
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  20 passed (20)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

The spike resolves `@objectstack/plugin-security` through its `dist/`, so plugin-security was rebuilt first. The new condition's text is in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`.
</details>

<details><summary>One-shot ablation (not committed)</summary>

- Tool: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, under the lock. The anchor is the new condition in `security-plugin-rls-filter.ts` (1 hit, replaced by `true`). Blob `f1bb2ff4e4` became `099c25dc90`.
- Mutate leg: plugin-security was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` passed (marker absent from all 6 built files; the source marker was lost).
  - The owner crossing's unit pins: `3 failed | 23 passed (26)`. The `isolated`, `group` and org-less owner cases went red.
  - Spike: `1 failed | 19 passed (20)`. (h5c) went red.
  - Every control case stayed green.
- Restore leg: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`f1bb2ff4e4`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the whole-tree `git status --porcelain` is clean. After the rebuild, the present-mode preflight passed (marker in 2 built files) and the suites read 26/26 and 20/20.
- The direction matched the prediction: red.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 60 derived, 57 run, 3 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 commands off merge base `987ff33b8`. Each command ran with its exit captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciled the records:

```text
Run reconciliation — 60 derived, 57 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 57 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).
```

- 56 of the 57 were re-run at `471f235499`, all exit 0. Among them, `check-adr-0087-registration` reads: `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (already-registered)`.
- `check-comment-mask-corpus` (exit 0) is the repo-wide comment-mask sweep. It was taken at `0135956739`, whose sources equal `471f235499`'s.
- NOT MEASURED, left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it needs every package's `dist/`.
  - `check:i18n`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it needs the workspace CLI build.
  - `check:type-check-debt`: its closure build never got the shared lock (queue-timeout). The two touched packages' own typechecks, both exit 0, give the narrower reading.
</details>

<details><summary>Full dogfood battery (the title carries a bang)</summary>
